scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:personal: playwright test --config playwright.personal.config.ts --project desktop-chromium && playwright test --config playwright.personal.config.ts --project mobile-chromium
scripts.test:projects: playwright test --config playwright.projects.config.ts --project desktop-chromium && playwright test --config playwright.projects.config.ts --project mobile-chromium
scripts.test:knowledge: playwright test --config playwright.knowledge.config.ts --project desktop-chromium && playwright test --config playwright.knowledge.config.ts --project mobile-chromium
